notes.title: Oh Baby Kart Patch 1.15B
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes & Leagues Solos Tournament[/h1]

[h2]⚙️ OPTIMIZATION [/h2]

This patch is to improve disconnects, but also load-in times. A lot of art needed to be optimized and we took this one step further. It will also reduce the space required for Oh Baby Kart. This is a needed step in preparing for how OBK Mobile will work. 
- Stage optimisations (including big stages that had issue load-ins, such as Hedges and Volcano)
- Icon loading optimizations

[h2]⏱️  TIME TRIAL BADGES[/h2]

Time trial badges have been updated (Bronze, Silver, Gold and Red). There will be a new time trial event soon(ish). There is no reset though to be clear, so keep working on those times!

[h2]🛡️ GUILD INFO[/h2]

1. A special variation of the Champion Kart in HOH colors have been given to the winners of the guild wars last year (who raced).

2. Guild Banners are integrated, we will need to give you a form to decide who to allocate these banners to, as once allocated, they will not be removed. More info in the next few weeks here.

We still need time to prep guilds going forward. Again, we advise to not do anything drastic until a full video explains guilds going forward for OBK and future games.

[h2]🏎️  LEAGUE SEASON 1 SOLOS TOURNAMENT 3 SIGN UPS AND SPONSORSHIP FORM ARE NOW OPEN![/h2]

(Check our discord for more information)

For more detailed information on tournament rules, sponsorship information, and prizes, please read this information sheet: [url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1G1idIN0dBY64eQwRXJFiHPBbYy_R9EJBES1dHd1B0Sg/edit?usp=sharing]HERE[/url]

notes.title: Oh Baby Kart: Patch v1.15
notes.content:
[h1] DEFENDER MODE [/h1]
[h3] Defender mode is here! [/h3] Try to get the highest score possible with a group of fellow racers. Protect the base from chickens with knives, bulls and even turtles with canons. 
[h3] Team up to compete on the Group Leaderboard [/h3] To kick start this mode [b] we are giving 500 BP to each person in the top 100 teams [/b] on the Chicken Defender Leaderboard (you can set a score with multiple teams, max 3000 BP per person). Leaderboard will reset on [b] December 21st. [/b]

[h1] DUO ROTATION [/h1]
With Defender Mode coming in, we have [b] temporarily [/b] rotated Duo Grand Prix mode out. We would like to work with our community to try and create more rotating game modes. 

[h1] CASUAL GP MODE RETURNS [/h1]
As the new players arrive, we have re-introduced Grand Prix and Grand Prix PRO (instead of PRO replacing the casual Grand Prix). Grand Prix PRO is once again unlocked at [u] level 30. [/u]

[h1] DIFFICULTY CHANGES [/h1]
We heard you out. Some cups are too difficult for players and have a very steep learning curve. RR cups [b] 1-14 [/b] have had difficulty tweaks but we have kept cups [b] 15 onwards [/b] as is, as we feel the rewards are equal to the effort required to beat these cups. 

[h1] WEEKLY PROGRESSION & SCRAP BOX ADDITION [/h1]
The weekly progression rewards have been adjusted. We have added a special Scrap Box instead of certain BP increments. 

[h1] BATTLE PASS [/h1]
New Battle Pass is here! You can no longer purchase the Dino Pass, with that we introduce the new Pirate Pass - full of new goodies, a unique skin and Pirate loot boxes! As always, you [b] KEEP THE BATTLE PASSES [/b] you have previously purchased. 

[h3] GAMEPLAY CHANGES [/h3] [list]
[*]Dazes carrying through hoops stopped momentum and sometimes prevented players from engaging the hoop, thus falling down. This has been patched
[*]Visual map fixes 
[*]Descriptions and localisations
[*]Some recipes that weren't working, are now working
[/list]

Hello everyone!

We’ve got another patch coming today! All the details are below, so let’s jump straight into it!

[h2]Topics for this update[/h2]
[list]
[*] Proximity Chat
[*] New Engine Type: No Drift
[*] New Game Mode - Training Grounds
[*] Item Adjustments
[*] Hero Balance Changes
[*] Map Rotations & Changes
[*] Weekly Leaderboards and Reworks
[/list]
[h2]PROXIMITY CHAT[/h2]
Let us start off with the big new feature coming to Oh Baby Kart – proximity chat! Now, you can communicate with other racers in real-time when you’re close to them on the track. Whether it’s strategizing with allies, throwing playful taunts at your rivals, or sharing a quick laugh during intense races, proximity chat adds a new level of excitement and interaction.

[h2]NEW ENGINE TYPE [/h2]
In addition to Automatic and Manual modes, we are adding a new setting called “No Drift”. This new setting is aimed at brand new players to help them ease into the game and learn about the mechanics.

[h2]NEW GAME MODE - TRAINING GROUNDS[/h2]
Introducing a new training mode where you can further develop your karting skills and accuracy. This new mode is aimed at experienced players to practise harder mechanics. 

[h2]NEW MAP[/h2]
In addition to some slight map adjustments, a new musical map will be appearing! Keep an eye out for it and let us know what you think.

[h2]ITEM ADJUSTMENTS[/h2]
The following items will get tracking and collision adjustments:
[list]
[*] Beachball
[*] Grappling hook
[*] Shiba rocket
[*] Capi Homing rocket
[*] Ultimates that involve projectiles
[/list]
[h2]PROGRESSION REWARDS AND LEADERBOARDS[/h2]
Rewards for weekly quests have been changed and updated. Weekly group leaderboards have been removed and are undergoing rework. We will update you soon once a new system is in place.

We have added a new tutorial stage for beginners! When you complete it in our main menu it will be found in the SOLO tab under 'more'.

[h2]Physics:[/h2]

[h2]UI/UX[/h2]

* Ha Yuri: Rose Booster has a 10% bonus speed. Ha Yuri's ultimate cannot trigger off herself anymore.

* Zach: Slip Stream + 20% bonus

[h2]General Bugs[/h2]

Descriptions, hot fixes and notable collision/respawning issues fixed. 

A big thank you to the community here! We have only just gotten started and there are many events running. Join our discord [url=www.ohbabygames.com/discord-join]here[/url] to learn about some of the events for awesome prizes.

notes.title: Tower of God x Oh Baby Kart!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

[previewyoutube=54hwZ735Bl0;full][/previewyoutube]

It’s finally here! Patch 1.0 is LIVE! We are also beyond excited to announce an incredible new collaboration in Oh Baby Kart featuring Tower of God! From October 8, 2024, to November 7, 2024, you'll have the chance to purchase exclusive skins from this hit series and take on a unique community challenge.

[h2]Tower of God Collaboration[/h2]

We are excited to be collaborating with Tower of God to bring players five brand new characters to the game! In addition to the characters, we will be releasing a new community event in-game where players will have to complete a global meter in the lobby. Every race adds points to this meter, and once it's filled, the entire community unlocks special rewards! Think of it as a “test” from the Tower itself—the more you race, the closer you get to victory and your rewards!

[h2]Global Community Meter[/h2]
Every race will add points to the meter. Below is a breakdown of the points:

Grand Prix Races (solo and duo): 4 points
Race Royale Races: 1 point
Players using a Tower of God character will earn an additional 2 points

[h2]Rewards[/h2]
In order for the community to get rewards, everyone will need to come together to fill the meter and reach the milestones below:

[list]
[*] 25% Filled: 1x Exclusive Wheels Unannounced Exclusive Kart
[*] 50% Filled: 1x Limited Lootcrate

[i]Important Note: In order for players to receive the rewards, they will need to at least contribute 150 points to the Global Community Meter[/i]

Get ready to climb the Tower and race to victory! We can’t wait to see you on the tracks!

notes.title: Upcoming OBK Patch 1.0
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

[previewyoutube=ssidB6DsMBE;full][ LINK ] [/previewyoutube]

We got a big patch coming on October 8, 2024, with significant changes. We’ve got all the details below, so let’s jump straight into it!

Topics for this update
[list]
[*] Free-to-Play
[*] Rewards
[*] New Maps
[*] New Game Mode - The Axel Tower
[*] New Items
[*] New Heroes and Tweaks
[*] Minor Gameplay Changes
[*] Difficulty Balancing for RR Cups and Challenges
[*] Localization
[/list]
[h2]FREE-TO-PLAY[/h2]
Let us start off with the big announcement. Oh Baby Kart (OBK) will be going free to play on October 8, 2024. What does that mean exactly? 

New Players. Starting on October 8, OBK will be available to download for free and all players will have access to most game modes and features, with some exceptions. Free-to-play players will have access to all online multiplayer game modes, but will NOT have access to a majority of current and future solo game modes (such as RR Cups and Challenges). This means that in order to unlock certain heroes that are tied to Challenges and RR Cups, you will need access to the full version. To unlock the full version - you just need to purchase anything from the shop (yes, that’s right, any purchase whether it be a battle pass or a collaboration item will give you the full version!). 

Existing Players. For players who currently own the game, that means you won’t have to do anything. The full version of the game is already unlocked for anyone who purchased the game. This means that those players can unlock all the heroes in the game, as well as any future challenges and RR Cups.

If you have more questions, check out our F.A.Q section below or reach out to us on Discord.

[h2]REWARDS[/h2]
If you already own OBK, we want to say thank you! When OBK transitions into free-to-play, we will set up the following rewards for existing players:
[list]
[*] 2x Preseason Boxes (now known as Base Boxes)
[*] Exclusive Bulma Maid Skin
[*] Exclusive Chibben Fast Food Skin
[*] The Dino Pass - this pass never expires
[*] Access to all existing and future game modes and challenges
[/list]
The Bulma Maid and Chibben Fast Food skins will be exclusive one off gifts and will never come back. This is to say thank you for your support and for being such an incredible community! 

We also have additional rewards for players who went above and beyond:

[list]
[*] Players who are level 69+ will receive the School Huntress Skin
[*] Players who are level 100+ will receive a Tire Box (Epic Lootbox)
[*] First 100 players who reached Level 100 have received the Floral Border, a border that was only given to 100 people and will never come back
[/list] 
[i]Note - additional rewards may be given and distributed on top of everything above in the form of additional lootboxes/BP. [/i]

Again, we want to thank every single one of you for your amazing support! We hope that you will enjoy these special rewards!

[h2]NEW MAPS[/h2]
The upcoming patch will also introduce 6 new maps. Additionally, 4 of these new maps will be special sprint maps. A sprint map is a one way map with checkpoints along the way. Instead of a repeating loop, a sprint map really rewards those who know the full map and the position of what is to come. 

[h2]NEW GAME MODE - THE AXEL TOWER[/h2]
Big shoutout to Axelmeow and the art team! Introducing the Axel Tower, a new crazy mode where players will need to reach the top as fast as possible! This new game mode will also have a special event with rewards. Without spoiling too much, all we can say is….good luck!

[h2]NEW ITEMS[/h2]
In addition to balancing existing items, we will be introducing new items to the pool. Depending on the map, you could turn into a rubber ducky, or make someone else turn into a turtle. 

[h2]NEW HEROES AND TWEAKS[/h2]
There will be new heroes coming with this patch. We won’t be spoiling too much so we’ll only reveal 2 heroes now.

[h3]Elbow, the Dragon Duck[/h3]
Elbow has a special ultimate that allows him to get full speed boost and steer if the first boost hits someone nearby. It’s a very risky ultimate because not only will you need to land it on to another driver, you have to also be able to control the new bonus steer on the hit. High Risk, High reward.|

[h3]Pas, some Random Game Designer[/h3]
Pas' mechanics revolve around coins. He has the strongest boost in the game, but not only does his boost require triple the most expensive ultimate in the game, it will also remove all his coins upon usage. Additionally, he needs 25 coins to actually get the coin boost. 

A number of heroes will also get their stats tweaked.

[h2]MINOR GAMEPLAY CHANGES[/h2]
After extensive testing, we realised that the difference between automatic and manual drifting was too wide. As such, we have improved the balancing of both and also increased the overall pace of the game. You want speed? We will give it to you!

[h2]DIFFICULTY BALANCING[/h2]
We heard you out and changes in the difficulty curve of the RR Cups and Challenges have been made to allow for a more pleasant experience. 

[h2]LOCALIZATION[/h2]
With this patch, we will be supporting more languages. These include:
 
[list]
[*] French
[*] Korean
[*] Japanese
[*] Simplified Chinese
[*] Traditional Chinese
[*] Dutch
[*] Vietnamese
[*] Spanish
[*] German
[/list]
A big shout out to our community members who have been helping us translate the game! 

We’ve got a few other changes but we’ll leave them shrouded in mystery for you guys to find out! That is all we have for you for now. We hope that you will enjoy this amazing new patch!

[h2]FREE TO PLAY - F.A.Q
[/h2]
[i]I bought Oh Baby Kart, what do I do?[/i]

Nothing! You already have access to the full game. In fact, if you owned the game before October 8, 2024, then you have access to additional rewards (see “Rewards” section).

[i]I don’t have Oh Baby Kart but I want to play it. What should I do?[/i]

You can either buy the game on Steam before October 8, 2024 and receive some of the additional rewards mentioned above. Alternatively, you can wait until October 8, 2024 and play the online multiplayer game modes for free. Note that if you wait until October 8, 2024 and play the free-to-play version of the game, you will not have access to all solo game modes (some of which help you unlock heroes upon completion).

[i]I want access to all game modes and features. What should I do?[/i]

If you already own the game prior to October 8, 2024, then you won’t have to do anything. You already have access to everything. For new players who download the free-to-play version of the game, in order to unlock all features, you just need to purchase anything from the store, whether it be a collaboration package or a pass. 

[i]Does this mean all heroes are unlockable for all players?[/i]

All heroes will be unlockable to existing players or players that purchase the full version of the game. For free-to-play players, not all heroes will be unlockable. 

[i]What about skins for heroes, will those be free too?[/i]

No, hero skins in the shop will still need to be bought. Nothing changed there.

notes.title: OBK Patch 0.620891
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

I will be doing a dev log video next week on what we are working on - worth looking out for!

[h3]1) Collisions and Bouncing off each other[/h3]
I have done an adjustment to physics and collisions, more with walls and other karts. The reason for this change was it was still too bouncy which could be costly to the game. For those in Alpha there was a time when karts used to stick together, then we moved to extreme bounce - although this still needs more fine tuning, it should be closer to a much better feeling with less crazy bounces on maps such as Sky Dragons.

[h3]2) Item Changes[/h3]
[b]Item Longevity:[/b]
Some items have been changed to not last so long. For example, a beachball could persist for more than 10 seconds, which sort of breaks 'intention'. The intention of a player firing the beachball is to hit immediately or at most have a few seconds to bounce off a wall, and so gameplay should reflect that. The ball should not persist so long that a player in 1st can somehow hit a player in 10th, after 6 seconds. This is tuned to most items in the game.

[b]OhBoBomb:[/b]
I have actually removed this item in 98% of cases, if not 100%. The reason for this came from community discussions. A player who is hit at first is likely going to be sent back to the shadowrealm not because of the OhBoBomb directly, but the players before them. The coin loss further adds to the loss. The solution was to remove it but more importantly allow Bonks to be accessible to other positions besides people so far at the back or tail end of the race. We still iterate but I believe this is a step in the right direction. Bonks still have global cooldowns to prevent max spamming (remember Beta 1?)

[h3]3) Map Fixes[/h3]
More colliders fixed, poor out-of-bound magnet zones and hoops to improve flow of maps. 

[h3]4) Localisation[/h3]
We are now looking for people who would like to help with localization. We have now started to set up all the items and are aiming for full multiple language support. 

[h3]5) Hero Changes[/h3]
[b]Huntress[/b]
Huntress rocket is 10% more ultimate cost

[b]Jez[/b]
Freezing Boost timer of coin vaccum reduced from 3 to 1.5 seconds

[b]Suit Shiba [/b]
Ultimate costs reduced by 3%

[b]Ohbibi[/b]
Drift Boost power 5% buff

[b]Cobie[/b]
Ultimates have 5% reduced cost

[b]Filian[/b]
Drift boost power increased 2%

[b]Capy[/b]
Drift boost power increased 3%

[b]Squidward[/b]
Drift boost power increased 0.5% (he is very sensitive to these adjustments)

[b]SpongeBob/Otto[/b]
Drift Boost power increased by 5%

[b]Peanut[/b]
Passive switched to Beachballs give speed

[b]Chibben[/b]
Drift boost power increased 3%

Hope you enjoy this patch, look forward to seeing you on the track!

notes.title: Oh Baby Kart Patch v0.5
notes.content:
[h1]OBK PATCH v0.5[/h1]

[previewyoutube=EcP8tQRmCv8;full][/previewyoutube]

Hello everyone, a big patch update! We heard you out and have done a complete revamp!

[h2]NEW HERO PASSIVES[/h2]

Get ready for a shake up! Every hero’s ultimate has a new passive ability. This means they will have passive bonuses from using specific items. There have been many changes to each hero and with the inclusion of passives the entire game has been shook up. 

Example of some passives:
[list]
[*] OhBibi when using a rocket will get drift boost bonus
[*] Jez when using ice rockets can get ultimate fill
[*] When Peanut uses bull boosters he has increased steer
[/list]
[h2]NEW HEROES[/h2]

Welcome our two new heroes, each with 3 new ultimates:

[h3]Shapes The Burtle[/h3]
[list]
[*] Slip and Slide: Burtle slips and slides with a subtle increase in steer and speed to do tricks around certain maps!
[*] Team Burgers: Serve burgers to your team! Each burger is a special item that gives the user a mini burger shield and speed boost!
[*] Burger Bang: Shapes slows down and is unable to drift, but after a few seconds Shapes gets a big giant boost a special shield to knock out the opponents.
[/list]
[h3]Rattini The Rat[/h3]
[list]
[*] Scurry: Improve your daze time temporarily and get a little boost. Perfect timing can prevent a full daze.
[*] Cheese Booster: Give everyone in the team a Cheese Booster which can trigger boost bull passives as well.
[*] Rat Thief: Increase speed and steer and steal coins from any other kart you collide with!
[/list]
[h2]NEW ITEMS[/h2]

Bullmerang - A special item that when you hit, gives you a bull booster.
Mealbox - An item you drop that will take ultimate charge from anyone who hits it.

[h2]NEW STAGES[/h2]

4 New Stages have been added:
[olist]
[*] McWassie
[*] NeoCyber
[*] London
[*] Paris
[/olist]

[h2]NEW UI/UX
[/h2]
The UI has been completely updated. After going through multiple iterations with our community, we figured out what was the best way to present the modes without overwhelming new players. 

If you want local play, it’s all there for you on the get go. Otherwise from the play button you will jump to your garage which will have all the options you need. We split it out to multiplayer vs. single player so you can immediately decide where you want to go. 
[h2]
REWARDS AND BATTLE PASS[/h2]

We are introducing our first iteration of a battle pass. This is completely free and given to every player. In addition, we have unique rewards for every character we will be expanding over time. These are your lifetime rewards which you get as you play the game over time! 

[h2]NEW RR CUPS[/h2]

We have added 4 new RR cups to the challenges and removed the map. We made it more organised so you can find the challenges in smaller packs. This allows players to find where they can unlock certain heroes and special items and karts.

notes.title: Dev Sneak Peek #4
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=WyjUlZSlc1k;full][/previewyoutube]

Wanted to share what we are working on!

[h2]1. Hero Passives[/h2]

We wanted to add some flavour to the heroes and build out more dynamics for each character. Each hero now has a passive which influences game items. This can range from Capy getting a mini shield when using a coin tornado to Jez getting ultimate bar from ice rockets. 3. New Maps, New UI/UX[/h2]

Expect new maps, new UI/UX and better overall flow. We heard your feedback and it's time to improve the overall flow of menus.

Finally, we are giving you all a heads up regarding the Campaign mode in OBK. If you have finished all the campaign then just ignore this please. We will be reducing the amount of challenges after feedback from new players. This will result in some items you can get into campaign moving out. Come join our discord if you want to participate in unique community events! Congrats to all league players for an amazing first season. This weekend will be a special pro + pro league challenger event. Then following week the next season begins. As explained in the video, we are now working on events for rookies and also new players as well. Our intention was to first sort out our veterans and pro players so this will allow us to make special tournaments for newer players learning the game. 

Thank you everyone!

Regards, 

Pas

notes.title: Update Patch v0.19445
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes for our upcoming patch, v0.19445
[/h1]
Hello everyone! 

[previewyoutube=3FbVu8TfyUo;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Physics Improvements:[/h2]
We worked on making the controller just feel better. This update improves the physics, which should be snappier, more control in the air as well as improve poor collisions. We are actively improving this and would love for you to try this for a few days *before* providing feedback as new things take a while to adjust. Changing physics is a tough thing, as it can affect maps differently, but if there is a time to make the controller feel amazing for you, it is now. 

[h2]Custom Game Options:[/h2]
We heard you! We haven’t had time to put in a lot of options in yet, but we provided options to item pools in the custom game mode. We will actively work with the community in our Discord on custom item set ups. This allows us to build more insane modes with items that would otherwise never get to see the light of day, but also perhaps fine tuning a more tournament style item set up. 

[h2]Homing Missile Adjustments and Items:[/h2]
Homing missiles now have a stronger initial open speed. This does *two* things that change the item significantly: 
1. It causes the homing missile to be more levelled with the ground, meaning more counter play is possible.
2. The target *must be relatively in sight*, if you fire up into the air and hope it hits, the % chance of landing is significantly reduced. 

[h2]Hero Changes:[/h2]

2. Chibben trick jump bonus (passive) reduced by 20%
3. Peanut top speed slight reduction 2%, Drift power increased 2%

5. Fooo improved steer 30%. Improved drift bosting 2%. Bamboozle now has a 1 second longer duration on successful hit. Partner boost now last 1 additional second
6. Cobie slight improved steer 10%
7. Spongebob increased drift boost power 5%
8. Chimp Based max speed increased 10% 
9. Capy increased bonus from max coins 5%

notes.title: Major Patch v0.19230
notes.content:
[h1]Major Patch v0.19230[/h1]

Hello everyone, our notes for patch v0.19230!

[h2]Video:[/h2]
[previewyoutube=z_xNkQXdyTA;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]New UI Flow[/h2]
We heard you, and we want to refine our UI/UX flows. The new set up may need some time getting used to but we wanted to reduce the amount of clutter in each play mode. This also allowed us to introduce new offline modes as well!

[h2]Offline Split Screen / Local player[/h2]
A feature that was requested was being able to play offline and giving local split screen options. We added that functionality, so now you can play with your friends, partners or even practice offline whenever you feel like it!

[h2]Race Royale Cups[/h2]
A new mode is added where you can truly test yourself in unique Race Royale Cups. These will start easy but get harder over time. Be warned, the last cups are very difficult, but each cup offers very special rewards for those who complete it. For those who want even more challenge, try setting the best time as well!

[h2]Race Royale Changes[/h2]
The Race Royale mode was simply too unforgiving for new players (plus veterans were entering the normal Race Royales to complete quests), ultimately making a not so pleasant experience for new racers. This needed to be changed, so we made Race Royale a level 20+ only mode (Race Royale Pro) but to balance out daily quests that require specific characters - you no longer need to win, but just get to the last round of the Race Royale. 

We have also removed specific maps from the Race Royale PRO and GP PRO modes. Maps in the PRO modes should be a form of skill expression and not be heavily reliant on RNG/Luck. Examples of these maps including Parking Lot and Stadium. 

[h2]Map Changes[/h2]
Many maps were frustrating to navigate for newer players, so ramps were added to prevent players going backwards. This also improved skill expression and flow of these maps. These maps included Mars, Test of Ice, Test of Strength and Vault.

Another common request was reducing the brightness/lens flare of certain maps. We felt the game was simply too bright, so there have been adjustments on every map to be less glaring but also fit the overall tone of the map's theme. 

Water Park has also been set to 2 laps now. 

[h2]Item Changes[/h2]
Bonk + OhBobomb - Watching streamers and players get annoyed at these items meant we needed to do a much more influential change. Both items are now on a cooldown depending on player distribution in the race, as well as the time of use, meaning the time it is possible to get the item after use is very large and on smaller maps basically at 0. Furthermore, the OhBobomb in Race Royales are distributed differently, making it impossible for the last round players to pick up an additional OhBobomb. 

Rocket Daze has also been slightly decreased.

[h2]Hero Tweaks[/h2]
Cobie: New Team Ultimate - Golden Bull Item Drop. Giving all team members a golden bull!
Capy: New Team Ultimate - Team Capytan. Booster pads improved for all team members
Degen/Krabs/Huntress: Slight improvement in steer and top speed in max coins
Peanut/Chibben: Ultimate cost has slightly increased
Squidward/Flamingo: Drift speed slightly improved
Dib/Stardust: Improved slipstream

[h2]Game Score Update[/h2]
There are likely more changes that will happen for Game Score (especially those who are in far more competitive group leaderboards). For now, we have added a few more boxes to the current Games Scores. We have not changed BP distribution here.  

[h2]General Bug Fixes[/h2]
- Colliders in general are fixed 
- Rocket explosion/collisions improved
- Respawns of many maps were fixed
- RNG on maps in custom games fixed
- Drift Sounds breaking fixed
- Challenge maps are now compiled into 3, instead of 6 (they haven't vanished, they are just all in the old maps to prevent clutter)
- Fixed some recipes not showing
- Fixed some items not showing craftable/sellable
- Removed R3 shortcut on controllers to prevent camera switching randomly
- Fixed visuals for some karts not showing and other items with wrong icons

notes.title: Developer Update #1
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Shogun Season running smoothly and we are loving your feedback. We heard you out and wanted to update you on what we are working on next. 

[previewyoutube=DuIWsWN69Po;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]New Menu / UI Changes[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44765784/ce81c990d3462a4f4691e6ef904be5d5e7e8402e.png[/img]

We want to do a more organized approach to UI. We felt there was too much on the home page when you first opened the game. This was very overwhelming to a lot of our new players. We are changing the flow and separating modes out. 

[h3]Local Split Screen / Offline Play[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44765784/b628123490b93c82d700aee744543875b53169c2.png[/img]

A mode that was heavily requested was split screen for couch/local play. We are enabling this mode with a clearer flow for you to play with friends and family locally. All the items you unlock are there for you and your friends to enjoy. 

We are also providing certain modes offline, allowing you to enjoy OBK wherever you are! 

[h3]Race Royale Cups[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44765784/3953865886f22514a53fc22e2c6b527e7fcd5d43.png[/img]

Race Royale cups are a unique mode to OBK. These will start off easy and get much... much harder, they are a new take on the typical Grand Prix. There will be unique rewards from the Race Royale Cups.  Can you survive 4 Race Royales in a row?

[h3]Post Patch Metrics[/h3]

We also wanted to take the time to update the meta changes post patch. Although the Shogun Season patch was last week, we wanted to give insight to the changes to the current meta as well as a little update to the game economy.

Leave a comment if you have any questions or any suggestions or join our [url=https://ohbabygames.com/discord-join]Discord[/url] to stay up to date!

notes.title: Shogun Season is here!
notes.content:
[b]Race as the Shogun or the Huntress from Shogun Curse. A completely free update that comes with a lot of big changes![/b]

[h2]Summary: 
[/h2]
1. Shogun Challenges: Unlock the Shogun and Huntress
2. New Maps: Shogun & Shogun Elite
3. New ultimates, character balancing and new duo/team ultimates
4. New Shogun Lootbox
5. New Recipe crafting for unique karts and items!
6. New items in item boxes, as well as new item pool for every stage. 
7. New Group Leaderboard rewards
8. New Time Trial Red Times are set (Golds etc. remain the same)
9. New Map fixes, alterations to existing maps to improve flow.
10. Significant online improvement optimisations with Rollback Netcode
11. XP Increase across modes.
12. General Bugs/Fixes

[previewyoutube=PipM6QfpBkA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Full Notes:[/h2]

[h3]1. Shogun and Huntress are here![/h3]

Unlock the Shogun and Huntress in unique Shogun challenges. Easy mode for these challenges arrive in 2 weeks, until then goodluck! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44765784/c7e60a466ab23da71464c3b669480b62570e520c.png[/img]

[h3]2. New Maps: [/h3]

New maps have been added to the map pool! Shogun and Curse of Shadows

[h3]3. New ultimates, character balancing and new duo/team ultimates[/h3]

Here is the full changes in a briefer form (as its fairly extensive)

[list]
[*] SHOGUN: New ultimates - Demonic Strike, Double slice, Team Shogun Dash
[*] HUNTRESS: New ultimates - Reload Rocket, Ricochet Rocket, Team Coins
[*] FOO: Both ultimates have been improved by bonus speeds and slight cost reduction.
[*] PEANUT: New ultimate - Duo Torrent Speed. Steer improved and slight cost reduction on ultimates.
[*] FILIAN/CHOP: Chain and Daze now does not daze you if you successfully chain the combo twice, i.e. the third boost does not daze you. New ultimate - Team Chain Daze. Slight improvement in steer.
[*] JEZ: Slight reduction in Ice Vortex cost, new ultimate - Team Ice Vacuum. Increase power from speed items.
[*] PATRICK/MARU: Ultimate will not work when shielded, and when ultimate is active, daze time is doubled.
[*] ZIM/CYBERDOGE: Daze modifiers depending on state of ultimate (green vs. blue state).
[*] CL: Base speed increased. Slip stream bonus increased. Shuriken speed throw improved.
[*] ZACH: Improved bonus on speed items. Slip stream bonus increased. New team ultimate: When the ultimate ends if you are near a team mate, your team mates ultimate gets fully charged with a speed boost.
[*] SQUIDWARD/FLAMINGO: Clarinet ultimate last one additional bonus second. Slight increase in base speed.
[*] NOMAD: Max coin now set to 10. Improved base steer. Slip stream bonus increased.
[*] LOMA: Slight increase in base speed. Shield ultimate is now a team shield, with a short duration but also increased drift power during the shield.
[*] KRABS/TOMATOMAS: Slight improvement in steer. Coins have a small improvement in the initial boost.
[*] MEMBRANE/CACTIFF: Slight improved base speed.
[*] DIB/STARDUST: Slight increase in bonus speed from max coins.
[*] CAPY: Slight increase in base speed. Elcapytan ultimate has even more power from boostpads.
[*] CHIBBEN: Trick jump bonus increase. Slightly improved drift boost. Team wingman has been improved with greater bonus for team mates and yourself. Wing ultimate also improved by the daze timer goes up during the ultimate.
[*] OHBIBI: Steering improved
[*] OHBOBOT: Slight increase in acceleration and drift boost.
[*] COBIE: Slight increase in drift boost.
[*] DEGEN: New ultimate - Team Coin Rocket.
[*] GAZ/LABEE: Extra bonus on speed items.
[*] SHIBA:  New ultimate: Team Dark Shiba rocket (loses the Hoop ultimate). Dark Shiba ultimate has less daze time. 
[/list]

[h3]4. New Shogun Lootbox[/h3]

New Shogun lootbox is available. Shogun lootboxes are available on your weeklies, group leaderboards, tournaments, streams and we do plan to give some to certain level brackets in future as one off. Shogun lootboxes will only be available during the Shogun Season. We will announce when the season is about to end with a week notice. 

[h3]5. Recipe & Crafting[/h3]

Recipes are in! There are 69 recipes available and will allow you to craft unique items if you have the ingredients. Furthermore, the lootboxes from the crafting system have an improved item pool which is more unique and favourable for rarer items. Can you craft them all?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44765784/28c4f2be5455f849100c389461c7483c7fd6b754.png[/img]

[h3]6. New items in item boxes, as well as new item pool for every stage. [/h3]

A big change has occurred to the item pool. Items are now based on distance from the pack, the map itself and the first place position player. Furthermore, new items have been added to the item pool to change the flow of game play. We felt that items should not feel too RNG but support the player in their current position. 

Specific items have also been changed:
[list]
[*] ICE ROCKET: Freeze time has been reduced. No longer causes coin lost.
[*] TRIPLE HOMING ROCKETS: Removed from game.
[*] WASSIE BOMB: Explosion only makes a player lose 1 coin, instead of 3. 
[*] BONK: Daze time has been reduced slightly. Rarity has been reduced. 
[*] FRIES: Throwing forward has been disabled for now. 
[*] NEW ITEMS: Ram, Hammer, Coins
[/list]
[h3]7. New Group Leaderboard rewards[/h3]

Group leaderboard rewards have temporarily increased due to the new Shogun lootbox. Rewards have also been increased across the board.

[h3]8. New Time Trial Red Times are set (Golds etc. remain the same)[/h3]

We have decided to keep the gold medal times as they are, meaning if you already had a gold medal for a map, you still have it. Red times however been reduced and made more difficult to soon reflect the top % of players. 

[h3]9. New Map fixes, alterations to existing maps to improve flow.[/h3]

[list]
[*] SPACE STATION: Reworked the split section. The overall pathing meant only one option was really viable, we have changed this to accommodate a better flow. 
[*] PARKING LOT: Map overall improved in loading times and collisions. 
[*] SKYDRAGONS: Respawn points of out of bounds no longer take you wrong way.
[*] VOLCANO: Loading times improved.
[*] WESTERN: Short cut will now raise up instead of side ways.
[*] PRISON BREAK: Ending jump now provides an on rail to prevent players flying over the start line.
[*] CASTLE: Castle short cut now goes up instead of rotation. 
[*] LUNAR NEW YEAR: Fixed respawns. Hoop is placed at the beginning of the tower to prevent out of bound errors. 
[*] GHOST GRAVEYARD: Fixed random out of bound issue. 
[/list]

[h3]10. Significant online improvement optimisations with Rollback Netcode[/h3]

Stalling issues and server improvements have been improved with our rollback netcode. This should improve the overall online experience for all players. 

[h3]11. XP Increase across GP/Duo Modes.[/h3]

XP increased for Shogun Season! New XP in Group Leaderboards as well. 

[h3]12. General Bugs/Fixes[/h3]

NOTIFICATION: Improved visuals on receiving team boosts.
KART VISUALS: Improved and fixed some skins, karts and wheels displaying wrong icons or wrong models.
